summary: Frontend-only regression on 3 features: (1) Compliance Posture page, (2) LIVE/MODELED source badges on operational quarterly charts, (3) Share-to-Teams from Executive Board Report. All three flows verified working. Regression on Control Monitoring passed.

issues: Obserra Advisor panel auto-opens and overlays the right side of the executive dashboard (covering 'Generate Board Report' button on 1920px viewport). Users must close the advisor before they can click board-report-btn. Consider either (a) not auto-opening advisor, (b) rendering it as a non-blocking drawer, or (c) reserving horizontal space so exec buttons remain reachable.

action_items: Optional UX: Advisor panel auto-opens over exec controls (Generate Board Report). Not a functional bug (user can close it) but hurts discoverability.
critical_code_review_comments: BoardReportModal.generate() is triggered inside render (`if (open && !report && !loading) generate();`) which is a side-effect during render. Should be moved into a useEffect keyed on `open` to avoid double-fires under StrictMode.

In CompliancePosture rows, framework testids are slugged (e.g. framework-row-NIST-CSF-2-0) — good, but the '·' separator between percent and count is rendered without spacing in a few widths; low priority.
